# The C++ layer: `openrac/mod.hpp`

The C++ layer of the mod interface (docs/port/MODS.md, section 11): header-only, C++17, compiled
into the mod and never into the port. Everything here goes through openrac_mod.h's table, which
stays the boundary; no exception crosses it.

```cpp
#include "openrac/mod.hpp"
#include "openrac/games/rac1.hpp"
```

```cpp
static void load(openrac::Mod& mod) {
    if (mod.game() != "rac1") throw openrac::Error("this mod is for Ratchet & Clank");
    const bool trace = mod.setting<bool>("trace");
    mod.hook<openrac::rac1::Hero_TurnToHeading>(
        [](auto original, int32_t m, float accel, float damping, float limit) {
            original(m, accel, damping, limit);   // the game's own, or a mod's loaded earlier
        });
    mod.on_frame([] { /* once a game tick */ });
}
OPENRAC_MOD_CPP("my-mod", "0.1.0", load)
```

One library is one mod: the layer keeps one openrac::Mod per library, and each hook point's
callable in a static of its own (a load takes a hook point once; a later load of the same
library starts afresh). An exception out of the
load function becomes the mod's refusal (fail() with its message); one out of a hook or a
callback is logged with the mod's id, and a hook then calls its original, so the game goes on
(a hook that threw after calling the original has it called twice: do not throw there).

## `openrac::Error`

What load and the layer throw: its message is the mod's refusal, or the log's line.

## `openrac::Memory`

Game memory: typed reads and writes at game addresses. Reads and writes copy (any alignment); ref() gives an lvalue where the address is aligned for T.

| Member | |
|---|---|
| `explicit Memory(std::uint8_t* base)` |  |
| `template <class T> T read(gaddr address) const` |  |
| `template <class T> void write(gaddr address, const T& value) const` |  |
| `template <class T> T& ref(gaddr address) const` |  |
| `void* pointer(gaddr address) const` |  |
| `std::uint8_t* base() const` |  |

## `openrac::Mod`

The mod as the port loaded it: the table, the handle, and what the mod takes of the game.

| Member | |
|---|---|
| `Mod(const openrac_api* api, openrac_mod* handle)` |  |
| `const openrac_api& api() const` |  |
| `openrac_mod* handle() const` |  |
| `std::string_view game() const` |  |
| `std::string_view version() const` |  |
| `std::string_view platform() const` |  |
| `std::string_view openrac_version() const` |  |
| `unsigned api_major() const` | The port's interface version: at least what the mod was built for, else it is not loaded. |
| `unsigned api_minor() const` |  |
| `void log(LogLevel level, const std::string& text) const` |  |
| `void debug(const std::string& text) const` |  |
| `void info(const std::string& text) const` |  |
| `void warn(const std::string& text) const` |  |
| `void error(const std::string& text) const` |  |
| `void fail(const std::string& reason) const` | During load: why the mod refuses (throwing an openrac::Error from load does the same). |
| `template <class T> T setting(const char* key) const` | A setting of the manifest's, as T: bool for "bool"; an integer type for "int"; float or double for "float"; std::string for "choice" and "string". |
| `template <class HookPoint, class F> void hook(F&& callable)` | Takes the hook point (a type of openrac/games/<game>.hpp) for `callable`, called as callable(original, args...). Throws openrac::Error when the port has no such hook point, a different signature, or the mod already took it. Only during load. |
| `template <class HookPoint> typename HookPoint::fn original() const` | What a hook point this mod took goes on to (as the callable's `original`), for calling it from elsewhere in the mod (another hook, a callback); nullptr before the hook is taken. |
| `template <class F> void on_frame(F&& callable)` | callable() after each game tick, in load order. Only during load. |
| `template <class F> void on_pad(F&& callable)` | callable(port, report, size) for each pad report, before the game reads it. Only during load. |
| `template <class Fn> Fn function(const char* name) const` | A game function by its name in this disc's build, as Fn (a function pointer type); nullptr when there is none. required_function throws instead. |
| `template <class Fn> Fn required_function(const char* name) const` |  |
| `template <class Fn> Fn function_at(gaddr address) const` | The function at a code address of the level loaded now, as Fn; nullptr when there is none. |
| `Memory memory() const` |  |
| `gaddr relocate(gaddr address) const` |  |
| `gaddr relocate_level(int level, gaddr address) const` |  |
| `int loaded_level() const` |  |

## Macros

| Macro | |
|---|---|
| `OPENRAC_MOD_CPP(mod_id, mod_version, load_fn)` | The two entry points of a C++ mod: openrac_mod_query (the id and version, as its manifest's) and openrac_mod_load, which calls load_fn(openrac::Mod&). A throw out of load_fn refuses the load with its message. |
